prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic cinematic couture archer portrait against a deep burgundy velvet backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman in side profile with calm focused expression, champagne-ivory satin gown with structured secure bodice, subtle gold leaf embroidery, long flowing skirt and heavy train; realistic recurve bow and clean arrow with natural feather fletching.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 full-body side profile, centered with negative space in arrow direction, burgundy velvet drape and dark studio floor, elegant archer stance with arrow safely aligned toward an empty background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Low-key studio, soft camera-left Rembrandt key, minimal fill, subtle rim separation, deep burgundy shadows and controlled satin highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp face, hands, bowstring and embroidery, realistic fabric weave, natural skin tone, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic 9:16 couture archer portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman in side profile wearing a secure champagne-ivory satin gown with gold leaf embroidery, long flowing skirt and train, calm focused expression, holding a realistic recurve bow with clean feathered arrow safely aimed into empty negative space, deep burgundy velvet backdrop, soft Rembrandt key, rich shadows, 85mm f/2.8, crisp fabric and skin texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, unsafe weapon handling, arrow aimed at person, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, blur, lowres, bad anatomy, extra fingers, deformed hands, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: burgundy satin archer reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve archer stance, champagne gown, burgundy velvet, side profile, bow, arrow, train and cinematic lighting; identity and floral embroidery details are replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep the gown silhouette, bow pose and lighting consistent; ensure safe arrow direction, clearly adult fictional identity, and replaceable decor.

changes: Clarified adult fictional subject, specified secure gown bodice, and added safe empty-space arrow direction.
policy_review.notes: Archery editorial is non-graphic and nonsexual.
